'''''The Essential Chronology''''' was compiled by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and released in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], just prior to the outbreak of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

This chronicle would later be [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|updated]] in [[36 ABY]].
